name: SRG SSR / SRF — Technical Guidelines for Commissioned & Co-Produced Content (HD)

governance.source: SRF — Technical Guidelines for Commissioned and Co-Produced Content and Program Acquisitions (V110, Dec 2025 / in force 2026-01-01)
governance.notes: SRG SSR, SRF unit (German-language, largest; governs SRF TV and Play SRF). Current house format is XAVC Long GOP 1080p/50 10-bit (SRF has moved OFF XDCAM HD422 1080i25). Video: MXF OP1a, XAVC Long GOP, 50 Mbit/s, 1920x1080p/50, 4:2:2, 10-bit, BT.709; safe areas EBU R95. UHD variant: XAVC Long GOP 200 Mbit/s 3840x2160p50 10-bit. Audio: AES3 PCM 24-bit/48 kHz, 16 discrete mono tracks; PGM layout 1/2 main stereo, 3-8 main 5.1 (L R C LFE Ls Rs), 9/10 Audio Description stereo, 11-16 second language; EBU R128 -23 LUFS +/-1 LU (SRG-group unified), true peak -1 dBTP, LRA target 8-12 LU (>18 rejected). TC start 10:00:00:00. Subtitles: STL or SRT sidecar, frame rate matching video. Delivery via VICO portal / SRG SSR transfer platform (or HDD/SSD exFAT). PSE not specified. Third-party/social outputs use -14 LUFS (out of scope here). Loudness is SRG-unified; RTS (fr) / RSI (it) / RTR (rm) publish their own equivalents. Language de-CH (also fr/it/rm), jurisdiction CH.

codec.notes: XAVC Long GOP (HD, H.264/MPEG-4 AVC Long GOP), 50 Mbit/s, 10-bit. Not XAVC-Intra.

container.notes: MXF OP1a per SMPTE 377M, Single Item Single Package.

color.notes: ITU-R BT.709. UHD-1 variant per ITU-R BT.2100 raster (still BT.709 SDR unless HDR agreed).

track_count.notes: 16 discrete mono channels (Dolby E by arrangement if >16). PGM: 1/2 main stereo, 3-8 main 5.1 (L R C LFE Ls Rs), 9/10 Audio Description stereo, 11-16 second language. Clean: 1/2 main stereo, 3-8 international 5.1.

layout.notes: Main 5.1 on 3-8; Audio Description stereo on 9-10; second-language on 11-16. Downmix coeffs L 0 / C -3 / R 0 / Ls -3 / Rs -3 / LFE -inf dB.

loudness.notes: SRG-group unified: EBU R128 -23 LUFS +/-1 LU, true peak -1 dBTP. Loudness Range target 8-12 LU; LRA > 18 LU is rejected.

subtitles.notes: Closed captions as separate sidecar files in STL or SRT, frame rate matching the video format. Open (burn-in) subtitles: Arial, white, drop-shadow/outline, kept out of letterbox bars. Audio description delivered as audio tracks 9-10 (not a separate service file).

metadata.notes: No metadata schema or filename convention defined in V110 (session-level naming guidance only for multitrack audio).

timeline.notes: First frame at 10:00:00:00. If no integral clean version, textless elements appended 30 s after content end. No bars/slate/leader specified.
